articleTitle: Agorapulse Homepage Teardown: Jan 2019 to Jun 2026
h1: How Agorapulse rewrote its homepage over 7 years

analysis-blocks.label: Jan 2019 — original state
analysis-blocks.heading: The original: product-led messaging
annotations: H1 opens with: "Social Media Management Simplified" — direct product statement.
Visible section headings include: "We support all of these networks.", "We are top rated by our users.", "Find out how Agorapulse works with the unique needs of your business.".
Section headings later removed include: "We support all of these networks." and "We are top rated by our users.".

analysis-blocks.label: Apr 2021 — mid-transition
analysis-blocks.heading: Mid-period: signs of a structural shift
annotations: Visual similarity to the previous snapshot: 96.3% — a moderate visual change.
H1 in this snapshot: "Take Controlof Your Social Media".
New section headings appearing: "Over 31,000 social media managers use our tool daily", "One easy-to-use solution, loaded with powerful features.".
Changes across this period appear incremental rather than a single redesign event.

analysis-blocks.label: Jun 2026 — current state
analysis-blocks.heading: Today: platform-first positioning
annotations: H1 now reads: "Drive Real Impact on Social Media. From Engagement to ROI." — formal capability framing, consistent with platform-level positioning.
New section headings include: "Over 31K+ social media managers use our tool daily", "Effective social media management with impactful business outcomes", "Features to boost efficiency and save time".
CTAs no longer present include: "Read on TrustRadius", "Read on G2 Crowd", "Read on GetApp".

messaging.after: Drive Real Impact on Social Media. From Engagement to ROI.
messaging.note: This change can be read as a deliberate update to the primary value proposition frame. No confirmed strategy is implied.

messaging.before: An easy social media management tool that works with Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, Google+, and YouTube. Start your free trial today!
messaging.after: An easy to use Social Media Management Software that allows you to stay organized, save time, and easily manage your inbox, publishing, reporting, monitoring, and team collaboration tools.
messaging.note: Free-trial urgency and exclamatory language removed. The new description reads as a neutral product category statement — more consistent with a platform positioning than a trial-conversion tool.

messaging.before: Simple & Affordable Social Media Management | Agorapulse

snapshots.above_fold_structure: Light blue sky-cloud background with centered headline 'Social Media Management Simplified', colorful floating social icons, and orange CTA button below.
Dark charcoal hero section with white headline 'Managing social media has never been easier', right-aligned product screenshot mockup, and orange CTA button on left.
Dark charcoal hero with white headline, product screenshot centered, orange CTA, followed by feature-focused content sections below.
Purple header bar, white headline 'Take Control of Your Social Media', split layout with product UI mockup on right, left-side copy with orange CTA and testimonial below.
Dark navy header with orange accent stripe, white headline 'Drive Real Impact on Social Media. From Engagement to ROI.', product UI screenshot on right with split-column layout, orange CTA on left.

visual-analysis.visual_shift_summary: The design evolved from a playful cloud-based aesthetic with bright accent colors (2019) to a professional dark-mode hero with product-centric layout (2019–2020), then shifted to modern split-column layouts with stronger typography hierarchy and muted color palettes (2024–current). Visual sophistication increased through refined mockup presentation, cleaner spacing, and more disciplined use of accent colors.
